title: 第六章     星辰大陆
content_zh:
太阳已经西斜，夜色逐渐降临，最终夜色笼罩着大地。山崖之颠，琼霄躺在草地之上，嘴里叼一根青草，微微咀嚼着，任由着那淡淡的苦涩之味在嘴中弥漫开来…

    遥望着满天繁星以及倒挂着的一轮银月，琼霄喃喃道：“星力……”

    来到这个世界已经十四年了，随着年龄的增长，琼霄对这大陆有了些许的了解……

    大陆名为星辰大陆，在这片大陆上，星力是这星辰大陆的唯一修炼方式。

    亘古到今，星力修炼经过星辰大陆无数代人的努力下，不断繁衍创新，最终走向了巅峰，在无数人的努力下，星力修炼逐渐渗入大陆的个个角落，在如今的星辰大陆，星力已经成为大陆唯一的主调没有之一！星力已经和人们的日常生活息息相关，已经变得无可替代！

    星力的修炼，历经无数代人的归纳划分多个等级，最低一级为：星之力，星之力分九重，而琼霄此刻正处于星之力九重，距离第二个境界已经不远了。而星之力以上的境界，目前琼霄已了解的等级为：化星境，而化星境之上则分为天地玄黄四个星境，他的爷爷正属于地星境后期巅峰，而他的父亲以及两位叔叔则属于地星境初期。天星境以上的境界琼霄就不得而知了，总之实力越强获得的尊重越多，星辰大陆每个人都梦想着成为绝世强者而光宗耀祖，然而梦想是美好的，现实是残酷的，没有历经磨难，何谈绝世强者……

    还有星辰大陆的功法更是不计其数，不过随着历史的变迁，流传出来的武学功法都只是一般的武学功法，想要过得更高级别的武学功法只能是加入宗派，或者是星辰大陆的学院，又或者是通过拍卖场获得。总之获得一部好的武学功法是可以使得在同等级的战斗中获得极大的优势。

    从理论上说，普通人想要获得高深的功法，基本上是难如登天，但事事无绝对，星辰大陆地域辽阔，幅员众多，大陆上也有着很多不为人们所知的无名隐士，在生他们命走到尽头之前，由于性情孤僻没有传人的他们，或许会将他们平生所创武学功法隐于某处，等候有缘人取之。在星辰路上千万别小看一些稀松平常的山洞，有可能山洞里面就隐藏着一些高深的武学功法，又或者是哪位大能的传承。总而言之，星辰大陆时时刻刻都会发生一些令人捉摸不透的事情来！

    总之想要修炼武学功法，前提是必须要进入化星境方能有资格修炼，如今琼霄离化星境只有一步之遥，然而功法似乎离他很远，因为他没有任何功法可以修炼，所以他必须要去寻找一部适合他修炼的功法才行，要不然对于琼霄来说这是一个致命的打击！

    啊！……咆哮了几声后，琼霄的情绪慢慢的平息了下来，又重归了往日的冷漠，心想着自己的处境，琼瑶苦涩的摇了摇头……

    琼霄所在的区域只是星辰大陆的北方的陆地，这块陆地上有六大帝国分别是：星辰帝国、新月帝国、卡其顿帝国、苍穹帝国、冰封王国、以及大乾王朝。这六大帝国虽然敌对，有一句话这样说：没有永远的敌人，只有永远的利益。所以六大帝国之间又有着一些非比寻常的合作，其中最突出的就是六大帝国合作的院校——星辰学院。从星辰学院走出去的学生都有机会进入六大帝国朝廷内担任要职。琼霄所想也是如此，想要查明真相家族覆灭的来龙去脉，唯有进入帝国朝廷方能获得机会，所以星辰帝国的名额他必须要拿到……
content_en:
The sun has set in the west, night is gradually falling, and finally night covers the earth. On the top of the cliff, Qiong Xiao was lying on the grass, holding a piece of grass in her mouth, chewing it slightly, letting the faint bitter taste spread in her mouth...

    Looking at the stars in the sky and the silver moon hanging upside down, Qiong Xiao murmured: "Star power..."

    It has been fourteen years since he came to this world. As he grows older, Qiong Xiao has a little understanding of this continent...

    The continent is called the Star Continent. On this continent, star power is the only way to practice in this continent.

    From ancient times to the present, Star Power cultivation has continuously multiplied and innovated through the efforts of countless generations of people in Star Continent, and finally reached its peak. With the efforts of countless people, Star Power cultivation has gradually penetrated into every corner of the continent. In today's Star Continent, Star Power has become the only main theme in the continent! Star Power has been closely related to people's daily life and has become irreplaceable!

    The cultivation of star power has been divided into multiple levels after countless generations. The lowest level is: star power. Star power is divided into nine levels. Qiong Xiao is currently at the ninth level of star power, not far from the second realm. As for the realm above the power of the star, the level that Qiong Xiao currently knows is: the star realm, and above the star realm, it is divided into four star realms: heaven, earth, black and yellow. His grandfather belongs to the peak of the late earth star realm, while his father and two uncles belong to the early earth star realm. Qiong Xiao’s realm above the Heavenly Star Realm is unknown. In short, the stronger the strength, the more respect he gets. Everyone in the Star Continent dreams of becoming a peerless strong man and honoring his ancestors. However, dreams are beautiful, but reality is cruel. Without going through hardships, there is no such thing as a peerless strong man...

    There are countless martial arts techniques in the Star Continent. However, with the changes in history, the martial arts techniques that have been circulated are just ordinary martial arts techniques. If you want to obtain higher-level martial arts techniques, you can only join a sect, or an academy in the Star Continent, or obtain them through auctions. In short, acquiring a good martial arts technique can give you a great advantage in battles of the same level.

    Theoretically speaking, it is basically as difficult for ordinary people to acquire advanced skills as to climb to the sky, but there are no absolutes. The Star Continent is vast and has a large territory. There are also many nameless hermits on the continent who are not known to people. Before their lives come to an end, they, who have no successors due to their lonely temperament, may hide the martial arts skills they have created somewhere, waiting for someone who is destined to take them. Don't underestimate some ordinary caves on the Star Road. There may be some profound martial arts skills hidden in the caves, or they may be the inheritance of some great master. All in all, there are some unpredictable things happening in Star Continent all the time!

    In short, if you want to practice martial arts, you must enter the Star Transformation Realm to be qualified to practice. Now Qiong Xiao is only one step away from the Star Transformation Realm, but the skills seem to be far away from him, because he does not have any skills to practice, so he must find a skill suitable for him to practice. Otherwise, this will be a fatal blow to Qiong Xiao!

    ah! ...After roaring a few times, Qiong Xiao's mood slowly calmed down, and she returned to her former indifference. Thinking about her situation, Qiong Yao shook her head bitterly...

    The area where Qiongxiao is located is only the land in the north of the Star Continent. There are six empires on this land: the Star Empire, the Crescent Empire, the Cacedon Empire, the Sky Empire, the Frozen Kingdom, and the Daqian Dynasty. Although these six empires are hostile, there is a saying: There are no eternal enemies, only eternal interests. Therefore, there are some unusual cooperations between the six empires, the most prominent of which is the Academy of Stars, a school that the six empires cooperate with. Students who graduate from Star Academy will have the opportunity to enter important positions in the courts of the six empires. Qiong Xiao thought the same thing. If he wanted to find out the truth about the demise of his family, he could only get the chance by entering the imperial court, so he had to get the quota in the Star Empire...
